_comment: Parameters for the dev stack (sepsis-dev). Use a separate AWS account per environment. Budget and alert emails come from BUDGET_EMAIL / ALERT_EMAIL. EnableSageMaker=false removes every SageMaker resource, permission and API call (the account has no SageMaker access yet); set it to true, TrainingBackend and MlflowBackend to sagemaker, once it is approved. TrainingBackend=ecs runs the pipeline steps as ECS Fargate tasks; MlflowBackend=ecs hosts MLflow on ECS (RDS PostgreSQL, S3 artifacts). EnableEvidently=true adds the Evidently UI service, the drift report task and its alarm.
